messages:
Maya Chen: DataCorp asking to start a VPC/on-prem POC next week. They want the one-time platform fee waived and Gold support for the trial. Can Deal Desk approve fee waiver + discount? @Jordi what are ops/SE needs?

Jordi Alvarez: We can support Gold but need 16h SE for env + SSO + KMS verification. Also need dedicated node reservation for the POC to meet latency SLOs. Ops requires 48h notice. Prep ETA = 3 business days.

Priya Singh: Finance numbers: platform fee = $50,000; annual license = $120,000. 30% off year1 = $36,000. Combined with fee waiver that is ~86k impact year1. Too large for a POC.

Priya Singh: Suggestion: waive the one-time fee for the POC, offer 20% year1 discount, and include a conversion clause: if customer signs a >=$150k 12-month paid license within 90 days of POC end, convert the waived fee into a credit on year1 invoice. Otherwise the waived fee is non-refundable consideration.

Maya Chen: I'll present 20% + conversion clause to DataCorp. They prefer lower upfront costs but expect procurement in 60-90 days post-POC.

Owen Patel: Legal checks out the conversion wording. Proposed contract line approved: "If Customer executes a 12-month paid platform license >= $150,000 within 90 days of POC completion, Redwood will apply a credit equal to the waived one-time platform fee to Customer's first invoice. If not, the waived fee will be treated as non-refundable consideration for POC services."

Jordi Alvarez: For SOW: add SE 16h, ops reservation owner/contact, KMS access checklist, and "Dedicated reservation for POC week - ops to be notified 2 business days prior."

Maya Chen: I'll update the SOW with the checklist and contract clause, send to DataCorp for countersignature.

deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk Request DD-2026-211 submitted by @Maya Chen - waive platform fee for POC, 20% first-year discount, credit-on-commit >=$150k within 90 days clause, SE hours + dedicated nodes in SOW. Action: APPROVE / DENY / COUNTER.

Priya Singh: Approve pending SOW shows SE hours and ops cost center. Discount capped at 20% and credit conversion conditions as stated.

deal-desk-bot: DD-2026-211 status: APPROVED (Priya Singh, Owen Patel). Terms recorded.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. Moving to SOW -> signature. Will post SOW link here once updated.
